# wikimedia

Floor plans from Wikimedia Commons (file list from WAFFLE, https://github.com/TAU-VAILab/WAFFLE). Each file
keeps its Commons licence (table below). Credit each file as given. CC BY-SA files: adaptations you share
must use the same licence. `LicenseRef-No-known-copyright-restrictions` marks files (mostly British Library
book scans on Flickr Commons) whose holder states no known copyright restrictions.

Changes: files renamed; large rasters downscaled to at most 3,000 px and saved as JPEG. SVG files are
unchanged.
